description: List contacts and companies from Odoo (res.partner), newest first. Returns total, the page and next_offset (null at the end). Filters: search (name, e-mail or reference), companies_only, customers_only.

companies_only.description: Only return companies, not individual contacts

customers_only.description: Only return partners marked as customers

offset.description: Number of entries to skip (for paging)

name: list_odoo_partners
